owner_decision: Permanently remove mandatory Human participation from Theme Chokepoint evaluation, freeze, and CI release gates.

precedence.rule: For evaluations finalized on or after the effective date, this policy overrides any earlier requirement for Human annotation, Human signatures, Human double-blind receipts, Human adjudication, or Human Top-10 approval as a pass/fail prerequisite.

required_automated_gates.requirement: All submissions and derived states pass the versioned schema and mechanical validator.
Contract, task, evidence, prompt, validator, result, manifest, and holdout hashes match their sealed receipts.

required_automated_gates.comparison: independent model run versus fixed reference
independent model run versus fixed reference
independent model run versus fixed reference

required_automated_gates.requirement: Versioned repeatability, insufficient-evidence, and time-cutoff suites pass their declared automated thresholds.
Top-risk failures are deterministically ranked and persisted with evidence, root-cause category, and remediation status; no manual approval is required.
Holdout inputs and expected outputs remain sealed from evaluated runs.

rollback_or_change_rule: A future policy may add advisory processes but must not restore a mandatory Human pass/fail gate unless the Owner explicitly revokes or supersedes this policy in a new machine-readable policy version.
